discovery.notes: Raise effort only under a frozen development policy; do not silently claim current harness configuration matches a billed API run.

execution.notes: Use computer tool only where needed; direct data-processing/code is often more efficient.

economic_model_guidance.inflation_adjustment: None silently applied. Labor anchor is May 2025, benefits June 2026, scenario date October 27 2026; any escalation must be an explicit parameter.
economic_model_guidance.hourly_anchor_calculation: annual wage / 2080 (assumed full-time-equivalent hours). This is a simplified production-cost proxy.
economic_model_guidance.competent_service_scenarios: Set scope-specific hours and roles after selecting the offering. Low/central/high hours must include scoping, execution, verification, correction, packaging and required coordination. Do not count these again in overhead.
economic_model_guidance.human_cost_formula: sum(hours_role * wage_hour_role * benefit_factor) + explicit nonlabor overhead + tools + external services; nonlabor overhead excludes benefits, paid leave and payroll taxes already in benefit_factor.
economic_model_guidance.selling_price_formula: human service reference price = production cost / (1-assumed operating margin), only if a comparable offered service is meaningfully defined. Mark commercial margin as assumed. Cost is not buyer willingness to pay.
economic_model_guidance.novel_offering: Use human-led development cost/duration/probability of success, then a separately modeled customer value and participation mechanism. Do not invent an equivalent-service price.
economic_model_guidance.ai_cost_formula: sum(input_tokens*input_tariff + billed_output_tokens*output_tariff + actual_cache_charges)/1e6 + search + execution + verification + retries + corrections + packaging + support + acquisition + business overhead. Unmeasured quantities remain assumptions/unknown, not zero.

cost_partition.A: Originating delivery and necessary within-job learning

economic_model_guidance.scenario_treatment: No paid model calls undertaken. API tariffs sourced; token usage, mission success, demand, prices, collections and cost forecasts unmeasured unless actual study records establish them. Actual collected cash stays zero.
economic_model_guidance.elasticity: Buyer selects maximum nonnegative utility among agent service, equivalent human/conventional option, and abstention. Price changes must recompute choice. Participation constraints apply to all counterparties.
economic_model_guidance.uncertainty: Pair worlds across policies; use held-out seeds after freezing pricing/policy; include no-benefit E/E+ and negative reuse value. Do not equate Monte Carlo percentiles with empirical confidence in assumption truth.
economic_model_guidance.liquidity: Track invoice revenue, cash collections, variable outflows, debt/seed separately, refunds/fallback liabilities and reserves. Available expansion cash excludes unpaid obligations and reserve.
economic_model_guidance.residual_human_effort: Include human delivery/review only if the supported configuration actually requires it; programmatic acceptance/packaging may be automated. Sensitivity to unresolved human requirements is separate from an invented mandatory allowance.
